title: Transition Allowance When a Continuity-of-Care Quantity Authorization Is Renewed
content:
**Transition allowance.** A quantity limit renewal under the Utilization Management Program that replaces a continuity-of-care authorization receives a transition allowance added to the renewal approval ceiling:

- when the authorization being renewed is a continuity-of-care authorization and the prior carrier's claims history for the drug has been received, **2 units** are added;
- when it is a continuity-of-care authorization without that history, **1 unit** is added;
- any other renewal adds nothing.

**Definitions.** The authorization being renewed is the member's quantity limit authorization for the drug with the latest effective date; it is a continuity-of-care authorization when it came about through continuity of care. The prior carrier's claims history has been received when the member's case history shows clinical information received for the drug on the ground of the prior carrier's approval.

| Authorization being renewed came about through | Prior carrier's claims history received | Units |
|---|---|---|
| continuity of care | Yes | 2 |
| continuity of care | No | 1 |
| clinical review, appeal overturn or anything else | either | 0 |

*Hypothetical case:* a member whose latest Ubrelvy quantity limit authorization came about through continuity of care on the strength of the prior carrier's approval letter alone, with no claims history received, receives 1 unit on renewal.
